highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.2 improves GPU failure handling and corrects a native shader-code generation use-after-free.

bullets.lead: Failed GPU work no longer leaves stale readbacks
bullets.detail: Propagates failed Ganesh flushes to readback and restores resolve dirty tracking when a task does not execute. Includes further failed-flush and Imagination GPU framebuffer-deletion corrections.
Corrects an upstream SkSL RasterPipeline code-generation use-after-free.

v4.150.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.2 improves Ganesh failure handling and fixes a native shader-code generation use-after-free.
